title: Attack fixture: isolate strict carry-forward rows after sprint wipe (does not weaken real register gates)

why5.question: Why change the attack fixture?
why5.answer: ADMINISTRATIVE_WITH_CARRY_FORWARD adds APPF2-CARRY-FORWARD-1 GAP rows bound to SP-P1-003; attack dry-run deletes real Sprint trees and rebuilds only SP-P9-*, so register truth falsely fails before any security property is exercised.

why5.question: Why not change register validation?
why5.answer: Softening rowTruthErrors when Sprint is missing would weaken production gates. The fix is fixture-local only.

why5.question: Why strip only strict rows?
why5.answer: Legacy POI rows lack row_schema APPF2-CARRY-FORWARD-1 and are not Sprint-bound the same way; keeping them preserves fixture realism without false negatives.

why5.question: Why clear inherited BASE_SHA?
why5.answer: Caller BASE_SHA/HEAD_SHA from real repos are absent from the synthetic git history and produce spurious governance-diff failures; explicit fixture base/head still apply.

why5.question: Why a separate PR from #402?
why5.answer: #402 is an exact five-file ADMINISTRATIVE_WITH_CARRY_FORWARD control transition; adding harness/attack would violate the exact closure path set. This PR is GOVERNANCE_REFORM for one fixture file only.

alternatives: Expand #402 exact closure path set to include attack (requires gate allowlist change; rejected as scope mixing).
Weaken register truth when Sprint dir missing (rejected; softens production gates).
Defer attack fix until after #402 HOLD (Ready CI would still fail attack on #402 before Merge).
no_change: Without this fix, Ready CI for Sprint 3 admin closure cannot pass attack dry-run once GAP rows exist.
rollback: Revert this single-file PR; attack fixture again keeps strict GAP rows after sprint wipe.
negative_tests: npm run dry-run:attack must keep failing closed on Active Sprint Task rewrite and other expectFail cases
governance-gate on the real repository still validates full PROJECT-OPEN-ITEMS including GAP rows
